posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
So much new info over the past few days!! Man, I really love this kinda thing. I really do.

1) I've said this numberous times here on the forum. We will see body-doubling robots. We first saw a bit of this in Argent Adepts deck, and the idea was solidified by art in Tactics. Scholars nemesis Biomancer (as seen in Tachyons card Sucker Punch) is the guy creating these things. I would have pegged that guy as a Unity nemesis personally, but Homunculus has ties to alchemy so it makes sense.

2) Some interesting "primary nemisis" listings for sure. Untiy Bunker and AbZero, as said by Christopher a few days ago, already have their primarys in the game. Unity being the primary of Iron Legacy though is realy interesting. Thats something Id like to know more about. Visionary have the Primary nemmy of Toy Master (when there is no nemmy symbol in the card game) is also interesting and I wonder if that is something that could be changed in the future. Also, look for Operative to be the main villain of whatever deck turns into the ninjas/assasins themed deck with Heartbreaker.

3) There is a "sinister six" type team just like we all speculated about called the Slaughter House 6. Look for these guys to be the ones formated into Vengeance type decks.

4) Adam, those covers are awesome. My favorite by far is the Baptism by Fire cover. So great. You're the man. Don't believe those things Christopher says about you.
